info.name: Screenings
info.summary: Private, tracked film screenings with viewer feedback
info.description:
**Private, tracked film screenings from your own Nextcloud.**
For filmmakers who send cuts to people they trust: an editor, a producer, a festival programmer, a handful of first viewers. Pick a video in your Files, invite people by email, and each of them gets a personal link to a dark, distraction-free screening page. You then see exactly how each person watched, and can ask for their feedback.
- **Send a film privately, or share it publicly:** personal links sent by email in a design you can change, an optional password and expiry date, an open link with email confirmation, or a public link without name or email. - **A proper screening room:** subtitles, quality choice, full screen, continue where you left off, and an optional moving watermark with the viewer's name. - **See how it was watched:** live status, a heatmap of which parts were actually played, and per viewer every play, pause, jump and device. - **Collect feedback:** notes at moments in the film and closing questions, reviewed in your own player with every note on the timeline, live while you watch. - **Any video:** browser-ready MP4s stream as they are; ProRes, MKV, HEVC, DNxHR and more are converted on your server with ffmpeg if you allow it. - **Hard to copy:** media is only streamed to an open screening page, in short-lived, encrypted pieces, never faster than about three times real time.
**Viewers are tracked.** By default they are told so on the screening page and in the invitation email (the text is editable per screening). Viewing data is deleted after a retention period you choose.
Needs Nextcloud 35, background jobs via cron, and preferably Redis. ffmpeg and a MaxMind GeoIP database are optional.
info.author: Guido Visser
